errors.text_span: Дял от общия брой наетите в икономиката
errors.evidence: The y-axis label is transcribed as "Дял от общия брой наетите в икономиката", but the actual label in the figure is "Дял от общия брой наети в икономиката". The definite article suffix "-те" is incorrectly added.

The description states that during months 7-12 of 2021, the line varies between approximately 2.0% and 3.2%. However, the minimum value in this period is at month 8, and it is visibly above the 2.0% line, at approximately 2.1%.
